proposed_widenings.name: halfDamageOnSuccess flag on save_gate ActivationPhase
proposed_widenings.justification: Shatter deals half damage on a successful save. Effect = DamageEffect | NoneEffect cannot represent halved damage. Encoding onSuccess as none is false; encoding it as full damage is also false. A flag or new Effect variant is required before any save-for-half spell can be encoded honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: taking 3d8 Thunder damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one

proposed_widenings.name: creature_type_save_modifier on save_gate
proposed_widenings.justification: Constructs have Disadvantage on the save. save_gate has no mechanism for creature-type-conditional roll modifiers. Secondary gap; single-unit pressure.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A Construct has Disadvantage on the save.

notes: Core shape (activation / area sphere / save_gate / CON / thunder damage / slot scaling +1d8/slot above 2) fits the existing surface completely. Blocking gap is half-damage on success: no Effect variant exists for this. Secondary gaps: Construct disadvantage on the save; nonmagical object damage. The save-for-half pattern is ubiquitous (Fireball, Thunderwave, Cone of Cold, etc.) and must be widened before any such spell can be encoded cleanly.
